context: Sakura and Ren go over a news article about labor reform for their column.
purpose: Two writers in editorial register, civic vocabulary in context.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 蓮くん、この労働政策の記事、読んだ?
lines.en: Ren, did you read this article on labor policy?
lines.style: soft adult writer voice, warm engaged professional delivery carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、委員会の議論、複雑でしたね。
lines.en: Yes — the committee's debate was complex.
lines.style: composed young man voice, soft warm thoughtful delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 新しい制度によって、働き方が変わるみたい。
lines.en: It seems the new system will change how people work.
lines.style: gentle adult writer voice, soft warm informative delivery carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それに対して、反対の声もありますね。
lines.en: There are voices against it, too.
lines.style: soft young man voice, warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 両方の意見、丁寧に書きたいね。
lines.en: I want to write both sides carefully.
lines.style: soft adult writer voice, warm committed delivery carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 委員の発言、引用しましょうか?
lines.en: Shall we quote the committee members' statements?
lines.style: gentle young man voice, soft warm professional delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、根拠が、はっきりするから。
lines.en: Yes — it makes the basis clear.
lines.style: composed adult writer voice, soft warm professional delivery carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 読者にとって、分かりやすい記事になりそう。
lines.en: It'll be an easy-to-follow article for readers.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm hopeful delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: こういう議論こそ、続けるべきね。
lines.en: This is exactly the kind of debate we should keep up.
lines.style: tender adult writer voice, soft warm earnest delivery carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: soft young man voice, warm warm collaborative delivery carefully
